thesis: The speakers argue that Google DeepMind's Genie 3 model represents a breakthrough by generating fully interactive, persistent worlds in real-time from just a few words, a capability that was previously impossible. They emphasize that while earlier models could only produce short, non-interactive video clips, Genie 3 allows users to walk through and control generated environments, opening applications in entertainment, agent training, and education.
